name: Sega NAOMI
description: Sega's 1998 arcade board, sharing its architecture with the Dreamcast but with more memory. Launched at around a third of the price of Model 3, it became a long-lived workhorse for games such as The House of the Dead 2, Crazy Taxi, Marvel vs. Capcom 2 and Ikaruga.

specs.memory: 32 MB RAM / 16 MB VRAM / 8 MB sound RAM
specs.media: ROM boards; GD-ROM via DIMM board

curiosities: NAOMI is a backronym for 'New Arcade Operation Machine Idea'.
Sega's R&D head reportedly chose the name in honour of model Naomi Campbell.
GD-ROM games are copied into RAM on a DIMM board at boot rather than read from disc during play.
Several NAOMI boards can be linked in one cabinet to drive multiple screens.
